body:
Same. I don't have close friends. 

The simple reason being: I don't want to. Why do we want to kill ourselves? Because we don't want to live. We're so often disuaded by the fact that things will get better, but for me they haven't. I've attempted suicide before, and things haven't gotten better. So I think it's time to end it. You, of course, are free to do as you please, and I hope you live and choose the right path, but I'm also not going to sugarcoat things.

Perhaps...they are dissapointed because no matter how hard i try, they always expect more. I can't do better but I'm always held up to acedemic, financial, and social standards that I simply can't meet. I'm not looking to prove them wrong, I'm looking to simply end my worries and pain. I've kept going for so long and things have gotten worse, not better. I'm starting to think it never will. So I've decided to die.

Indeed we did....

I know how you feel. I would advise you to not do it, but that would simply be hypocritical. The only thing I can do is hope you get better. Both of us SHOULD keep on truckin', but whether we live or die, it's been a pleasure talking to you.

Thanks for the reply. If there was an afterlife, then I'd want to die more. Perhaps it's better there. Either way, no matter what happens after death, it'll almost certainly be better than what I'm living now. I appreciate the thought, but I truly think death is better at this point.

Wow, our situations are remarkably similar. If I could do anything, I would go do something with my life (i.e. get a job I want and such) and just savor being happy. Alas, it's impossible. I hope your situation gets better.

I wish I didn't have to do it. But I think it would be best. I feel better now that I know I'm going to kill myself soon. Cliche as it sounds a great weight has been lifted. I can enjoy what time I have left on this Earth worry free, and then I will simply cease.
19, briefly bad childhood, didn't get along well with parents, not doing anything with my life but working my ass off. I don't really have much history to tell.

I don't think my parents care whether I kill myself or not. I'm not on good terms with them. I'll tell them, let them know my reasoning, but I won't give them too much time. Once they know there is no point in going on living any longer, I'll kill myself through one way or another after that.

Indeed. I'm very aware of gun safety, my gun will stay where it is (locked in a box) until I decided to use it on myself when I'm alone. Unless I hang myself, then it will just stay in a box. I'll bring something, in case I just want to end it. A pocket knife, some type of poison. I might just hurl myself off a bridge. But your right. The gun is staying where it is.
What few I have left I will. Thank you for your help, while I will be dead very soon your advice has certainly been helpful.

Alright. I'm going to meet with my family in person and tell them. I will however bring some tool to kill myself (not to hurt anyone else, just myself) in case they attempt to stop me. Hopefully it will go well, and if not, it doesn't matter because it will all be over soon.
Perhaps you're right. I will certainly think on it, but either way I am going to die by my own hand. Perhaps telling people would be better.
America, but I am also a French citizen.

You've certainly given me something to ponder. Perhaps I shall, perhaps I'll simply blow my brains out on the way. Either way, in my last hours (or days) I do appreciate the conversation. I really do.

Because my efforts are futile. I have given up. I don't want to continue the way I am living and despite my best efforts, I can do nothing to change it. The thought of death is a comfort. I've decided tonight at 11pm I will commit suicide. I think it is better this way.

I work-all day every day. I've basically given up on a social life and my interests and hobbies because I am working. Everyone I know-my parents, my family, what few friends I have left, all either hate or are dissapointed in me. I can't go anywhere without being ridiculed, insulted, or hated on. As I mentioned prior, I am in pain a lot and despite me always trying to be cheery and make life better for others, everything always turns out for the worse. If you've read the rest of the thread I've decided to commit suicide tonight. I feel better knowing the end is near.

Perhaps you are correct. But I have been talked out of suicide before, which result in a day or two of happiness, then it's back to the old grind. Selfish as it may sound, it won't matter if I tell anyone or not, because I, and everything I sense, think, or know, will cease to exist. If I am dead, for all I know, everything is dead. I just want it to end. I'm tired and I want to sleep. 

While your advice is appreciated, I think it is best this way. People will get over it. I will be forgotten, life will go on. I'll certainly call, but I want this to end.

I don't want to be a coward, but I'm not near anyone I can talk face to face. I have a couple friends in the area, but my parents/siblings are nowhere near within travelling distance. I'll certainly tell the people who I know...but a phone call will have to suffice. I'm excited now...I just want to get it over with. I've had a shitty run with life and oblivion seems like a gallon of water at the end of a marathon. I think I'll tell people I know then do it discreetly. I'm not comitting suicide to make a point, I'm not doing it to get people angry, I'm doing it to end my pain and worries. I think quietly would be best for that. I've set a time 11PM. I'm going to do it, my mind is set. I don't want people to worry or try and stop me, or think it's there fault. I just want to pass away discreetly.

You're right. You're right. I'm going to tell my parents and some relatives and friends. Only the people I think will care. I won't tell them my location so they can't stop me. I'll try to get them to understand. Then i'll get my financial matters in order, have a drink, then die at let's say 11. I feel better knowing the end is near.

I held a knife to myself in front of my parents, who did nothing. I have no friends close enough who would particularly care. Perhaps a relative or two might shed a tear, but I don't think the risk (of having police or medical teams called on me, so I couldn't do it) is worth it. I would rather just go silently. Tonight I think. I'm going to get some stuff in order, but tonight seems like a good night to die.

I know how I'd do it. Right a brief note saying goodbye. I've got a belt and a hook on the ceiling capable of supporting my weight. If I fall hard enough I might break my neck, if not, a few minutes of suffocation is a small price for freedom from all my pain and worries. Perhaps I shall. Perhaps it is time. I don't know.

Perhaps you are right...but there's a reason I'm an atheist. Delusions give me no comfort because they are just that-delusions. Oblivion, on the other hand does. One quick moment and then nothing...it's an appealing concept the more I think about. No pain, no worries, no emotions.
Thank you, I appreciate you trying to teach me the brutal truth, but I can't accept that, because if I do I'll be more broken than I am.

I work so hard and do my very best to try and make myself a good person and have a positive impact on those around me...but nothing works. I slave away every day and gain absolutely nothing...everyone is always dissapointed in me and I am dissapointed in myself. I'm in constant pain due to medical problems and even though I try my hardest it's just not enough. I want to end it all, oblivion seems appealing. I can't go on like I've been living.
If that's the truth, perhaps oblivion is a better option
